items.title: Is Nokia Attractive as AI Growth Meets Valuation and Execution Risks?
items.summary: NOK's AI and Cloud growth prospects strengthen its outlook, but restructuring costs, weak cash conversion and mixed valuation warrant investor caution.

items.title: Nokia Falls 3.4% in a Week as AI Growth Collides With Cash Flow Risks

items.title: Is VIAV a Buy Now as Growth Accelerates but Valuation Risks Persist?

items.title: VIAV Falls 11.6% in the Past Month: Is the Sell-Off an Opportunity?
